name: Hunting Ground Middle of the Forest II
source: maplestory.io /api/GMS/8/map/1000006 (local copy docs/research/raw/gms_v8/1000006.json); geometry identical in gms_v22
conventions: MapleStory px, y grows DOWNWARD. Tier ids T0.. sorted top-to-bottom (T0 = highest). Ladder from_tier = tier at the BOTTOM end, to_tier = tier at the TOP end (null = no foothold there). kind: ground = attached to map bottom; ledge = raised block standing on ground or an object top; floating = free platform; slope = sloped ground piece.

layering.ground: one continuous foothold chain (group 0) shaped as a valley: T23a y-865 -> T23c y-805 -> T23e y-745 (lowest) -> long slope -> T23g y-985 (highest ground)
layering.mid: door island T17/T18 y-1345 with door block T12 top y-1495; T15/T16 y-1405; T13/T14 y-1465; T9/T10/T11 y-1525; T8 y-1585

tiers.note: raised earth block (layer 0) standing on island T17: walls x=6 and x=264 run from y-1495 down to y-1350, so it is 150 px tall. The wooden exit door object is at x130 on its front face. No ladder: it can only be reached by dropping from T4.
central floating island (thick, rounded dirt underside, walls to y-1260); arrival point: 4 spawn points + exit out00 on it
same height as T17 with a 12-px gap, so it reads as an extension of the island
west ground plateau (2 autumn twin trees, stake fences)
valley floor, lowest point (yellow twin tree, stake fences)
long slope UP 240 over 360 (4 x 90-px pieces)
east high plateau (stake fences, yellow twin tree)

terrain_style: Tile set tS=grassySoil (raw WZ <layer>/info/tS). Grass-topped earth: thick bright-green grass fringe over olive-brown mossy cobbled dirt with embedded grey boulders; floating platforms have ragged dirt undersides; ground blocks are solid dirt down to the map bottom (v8 render). Background set bS=grassySoil: tiled blue sky (no.0), drifting white cumulus clouds (no.1, type 4 = horizontal scroll), a distant domed grassy hill (no.2), a single big leafy tree (no.3), and a horizontally tiled meadow strip with golden grass (no.4) with the strongest parallax (raw WZ back/<n>; sprites viewed at Data/Map/Back/grassySoil.img/back/<no>). This map's decor uses the midForest object set: white-barked twin trees with autumn-orange or yellow foliage, white wooden stake fences, lily-of-the-valley, yellow daffodils and a giant umbrella-leaf plant. Ropes have wooden peg tops. T4->T1 is a rope ladder.
